text:
Lena: Quick quarterly check-in: can each team post a 1-2 line status for milestone owners, what shipped, what slipped, and any immediate dep gaps? Trying to close the dependency grid before the exec review on Friday.

Ava: Product side — shipped the redesigned onboarding flow (feature flag on), slipped two analytics events due to infra quota. Owner: Ava -> will follow up with infra.

Diego: Eng - runtime v2 canary shipped to 20% yesterday. Latency looks good but saw increased memory churn in 16GB nodes. Owner: Diego, investigating.

Maya: Eng-SRE - saw the memory churn alerts tied to LRU cache eviction. Working w/ Jonas to test KV cache tuning. ETA tomorrow for mitigation config.

Jonas: Eng-runtime - repro'd the churn in local stress tests. Plan: tweak cache retention and land a hotfix. PR: <https://git.redwood/infra/runtime/pull/1287> (needs two more reviews).

Priya: Eng-platform - dedicated capacity rollout blocked by infra quota for region-us-west1. Contacted cloud vendor, vendor gave provisional increase but needs billing approval. Owner: Priya -> chasing finance.

Ava: FYI, onboarding flow depends on dedicated capacity for enterprise customers (pri: high). If platform delay lasts >48h we fallback to hosted route (non-enterprise).

Diego: Action items for owners:
- @Jonas land the hotfix PR today if possible.
- @Maya confirm mitigation config and post the diff.
- @Priya update capacity ETA.

Lena: Also need code review pings: which PRs are blocking ship? Keep it to 2-3 high-impact reviews.

Jonas: Blocking PRs: runtime hotfix above + small scheduler tweak: <https://git.redwood/scheduler/pull/332>. I'll ping reviewers in devex.

Maya: I'll post the config diff in eng-sre and include perf numbers.

Priya: Vendor expects finance sign-off by EOD tomorrow. If delayed, recommend temporary region routing to eu-west-1 as fallback (latency tradeoff).

Diego: Noted. For runtime v2 canary, if hotfix lands we'll ramp to 50% by tomorrow evening and monitor token latency.

Ava: Product asks for a single owner to update the dependency grid. Can someone own the sheet?

Lena: I'll own the dependency grid for this check-in. Please update the row with owners and ETA by EOD.

Evan (deploy-bot): Deploy started: canary/runtime-v2 -> 20% @1749991150.

Diego: Quick heads-up — two small follow-ups that might slip to next sprint if reviewers busy: backfill tests for cache and the PR to expose telemetry counts. Marking low risk.

Ava: OK — product will communicate fallback plan to sales for enterprise customers.

Lena: Summary for execs I'll prepare: shipped onboarding (flagged), runtime v2 canary (monitoring mem churn), platform quota pending finance, owners committed to hotfix + config by EOD. Anything else urgent?

Jonas: One ask: if reviewers don't appear, I'm happy to request a temporary reviewer list and assign. Will ping reviewers now. :pray:

Maya: I'll drop perf screenshots in the thread once tests finish.

Lena: Thanks everyone — please update dependency grid and mark shipped/slipped status. I'll consolidate and send the exec snapshot at 9am Friday. :white_check_mark:
